iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PROFILE::xml
       Returns the value of an XML profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::xml ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned XML profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned XML profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.3 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
